objective: Complete original Claude Google login inside Cross by following the actual Play OAuth failure.

accountVisibility.bug: BlackBox ignored the existing legacy visibility choice; two package-specific account enumeration methods also rejected USER_MANAGED_VISIBLE.
accountVisibility.fix: Use the shared resolver in both enumeration methods and honor the stored legacy choice after explicit per-package settings. Explicit denials still win; absent choices remain hidden.
accountVisibility.validation: Candidate built successfully; the reproducible repository patch produces the exact compiled source. No account records were edited.

consentContinuationExperiment.hypothesis: MGC drops an authenticator permission Intent because it uses a non-Activity AccountManager callback that only reads authtoken.
consentContinuationExperiment.change: On top of the visibility fix, retain the original MGC googleplay OAuth session and start the genuine microG AskPermission Intent once if returned, with its original callback and a 60-second timeout.
consentContinuationExperiment.interpretation: The actual request failed in the authentication service's non-OK HTTP response path before returning any permission Intent. Error code 3 alone does not prove a transport failure: microG wraps all exceptions from this block as NetworkErrorException.

actualAuthRequest.source: Existing GmsHttpFormClient request and error logs from the same login; fixed fields and local public-certificate comparison only. No extra request.

playDelegationCandidate.gboxStaticEvidence: decoded-original/smali_classes4/com/vlite/sdk/server/virtualservice/accounts/a.smali:11109-11236 validates the real caller, recognizes com.android.vending.mgc and writes com.android.vending as androidPackageName; callerUid is retained and normal callerPid assignment is skipped.
playDelegationCandidate.approach: Use microG's existing overridePackage authorization instead: keep the actual MGC package/UID/PID, let the original AskPackageOverrideActivity obtain consent, and forward its original retry=true bundle so Android AccountManager retries the same operation.
playDelegationCandidate.scope: Cross host, MGC caller, com.google account, googleplay scope, installed microG authenticator only.
playDelegationCandidate.deviceResult: Real delegation Intent returned, but no visible consent page; session timed out.
playDelegationCandidate.limitation: No token-return event in the capture does not prove no token existed. No explicit background-start rejection or activity exception was found. A submitted virtual launch is not proof that its UI displayed.

consentNewTaskCandidate.hypothesis: Reusing an existing GMS task can fail to display this consent page; the reused-task implementation discards start results and returns zero even after an exception. This is a candidate explanation, not a confirmed runtime exception.
consentNewTaskCandidate.change: Only the exact authenticator session uses an internal Java entry into the existing independent-task launch path. Original Intent and callback retained; ordinary task policy and AIDL unchanged.
consentNewTaskCandidate.deviceResult: Real microG delegation page found through recent tasks and allowed; original retry=true followed by hasToken=true.
consentNewTaskCandidate.userFacingDelegation: Companion accesses the account as Play Store
consentNewTaskCandidate.firstClaudeAttempt: HTTP 400 while the initial authorization was being completed
consentNewTaskCandidate.conclusion: The Play OAuth integration defect is repaired, but its repair alone does not make original Claude login succeed. The record does not prove that old-task reuse was the sole reason the earlier permission page was missed.
